blocks.text: Frequency counting and top-k selection are separate stages with different invariants. The map establishes one score per distinct value. blocks.text: After the first `k` arrivals, the root of the retained min-heap is the kth-largest threshold. A new arrival is either discarded, leaving that threshold unchanged, or replaces the root with a larger value, after which the new threshold is at least as large. Because the threshold is monotonic, an earlier discarded value that was no larger than it can never become competitive through later insertions. The heap therefore needs only the retained candidates. Keeping all history adds unsupported state, while keeping only the root loses the other `k - 1` arrivals required in the final collection.
